calls.reason: The claim says every AI startup, and a March 2026 WinBuzzer report names Midjourney as a profitable, bootstrapped exception. The report gives no detailed accounts.
Microsoft gave a $13B AI revenue run rate on its January 2025 earnings call, against 'none will talk'. It also reported $6.7B in finance leases, mostly for datacenters, last quarter.
In Sightline's tracker the 5GW figure covers only the 16GW due in 2026, not the 190GW pipeline. Crusoe's March 2026 campus names Microsoft as its customer, against 'demand that doesn't exist'.
Anthropic's audited S-1 says model development costs are generally expensed as incurred, which supports the opex point. No OpenAI policy was found.
Microsoft cut calendar-2026 capex guidance to about $170B on the evaluation date, citing capacity delays. There is no later evidence of a broad AI contraction yet.
